title: After London; Or, Wild England
author: Richard Jefferies
description: "After London; Or, Wild England" by Richard Jefferies is a speculative novel written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The book imagines a future England transformed into a primitive world after civilization has collapsed and nature has reclaimed the land.
